description: Prices home contents insurance for every featured insurer. Each plan has its insurer, price in S$ with GST, the date the price was checked, excess, key cover limits and a buy link. Prices come from the broker's stored price tables for Singapore. No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

belongings.description: The value of the home contents to cover, such as "60k" or "S$45,000".

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.

who.description: Whether the buyer owns the home or rents it.

name: get_home_quote
title: Home insurance quote
